source.label: ERA5 total column water vapour via the Open-Meteo archive API, hourly points averaged to days

note: Column water vapour, kg per square metre of the whole air column, from ERA5 through Open-Meteo. Not a global mean: a sparse grid cannot give one honestly, so the panel shows the tropical belt 20°S–20°N on a 10° by 30° grid weighted by cos(latitude), and the Niño boxes on 3 by 5 points. The global record is quoted from C3S, as reported. Climatology 1991–2020, ±7 days.
